Our mission is to enhance natural beauty and empower our patients to celebrate their beauty and feel their best. Owner and Medical Director Shelly Jubrey FNP-BC, MSN Her specialties include neuromodulators, dermal fillers, microneedling, ZO® medical-grade skincare, BBL, IV hydration therapy, medical weight loss, and hormone optimization. Shelly is deeply committed to understanding each client’s unique goals, prioritizing natural results, long-term wellness, and building lasting, trusted relationships. Her mission is to help you look and feel your absolute best—radiating confidence, health, and beauty from the inside out. Shelly is an Advanced Practice Nurse Practitioner specializing in injectables, preventative medicine, medical aesthetics, and whole-body wellness. She takes an integrative approach to anti-aging—combining clinical expertise with personalized, compassionate care. With over 16 years of experience in the medical field, Shelly’s background includes cardiac and emergency medicine, as well as serving as a clinical educator and instructor. This foundation brings an added layer of precision, safety, and depth to her aesthetic and wellness practice. Get to know the Bombshell team Nurse Practitioner Melanie Burgess Melanie is a Board-Certified Family Nurse Practitioner with over 16 years of experience in the medical field. Her background includes emergency medicine, and she currently practices full time as a pediatric primary care provider. Melanie is certified in aesthetic and wellness treatments including neuromodulators, dermal fillers, BBL, microneedling, IV hydration therapy, and hormone replacement therapy. Her clinical expertise is matched by a deep passion for preventative medicine and a commitment to helping clients achieve optimal health and confidence—both inside and out. With a gentle, knowledgeable approach, Melanie focuses on creating personalized treatment plans that support natural beauty and long-term wellness. Master Aesthetician Jessica Wilder Jessica is a Licensed Aesthetician and Licensed Massage Therapist in the state of New Hampshire, with an impressive 27 years of experience in the skincare industry. She is certified in HydraFacial, Glo2, BBL, chemical peels, laser hair removal, dermaplaning, ultrasonic facials, teeth whitening, lash lift and tinting, waxing, and ZO® Skin Health. Jessica takes a holistic and calming approach to every treatment, offering individualized skincare plans tailored to each client’s unique needs. She is known for creating a peaceful, restorative experience while delivering medical-grade results. Clients often describe Jessica’s touch as “magic,” and her calm, grounded demeanor helps foster long-lasting relationships built on trust, care, and transformation. Her focus is not only on skin health—but also on the well-being and confidence that comes with it. Administrative Assistant Kaleigh Tower Kaleigh plays a vital role in ensuring BombShell runs smoothly by assisting our patients with all their scheduling needs. With a background in pharmaceutical assisting and over 17 years of customer service experience, she brings both expertise and a warm, welcoming presence to our front desk. Certified in teeth whitening and ZO® Skin Health, Kaleigh is deeply passionate about skincare and makeup. She takes great pride in her work, going above and beyond to ensure every client's needs are met with care and efficiency. Known for her compassionate nature, Kaleigh genuinely enjoys connecting with people. She listens closely to understand how she can best support each individual, making every client feel valued from the moment they walk through our doors.
